hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (laptop; power- and thermal-limited, gross numbers). Provisional pending the desktop gfx1151 host.
change: Stage the small IQ codebook grids in LDS once per workgroup and read them with ds_read in the decode inner loop, instead of indexing __device__ __constant__ arrays. Under a lane-varying index a __constant__ grid is plain global memory and compiles to one global byte load per decoded element. Staged: iq3_grid (2048 B, IQ3_S), iq3_xxs_grid (1024 B, IQ3_XXS), IQ2_XS_GRID_PACKED (1024 B, IQ2_XS). Values are unchanged, so the kernel stays bit-exact.
method: Interleaved A/B (scratchpad/ab_leaf.py): each candidate built into its own cache entry, launches alternated inside one process, min-of-7 rounds x 30 reps, rows=1, f32 out, largest rank-2 tensor per family from Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_S.

leaf_bandwidth_gb_s.note: Controls are quants whose ISA is unchanged by this edit; they read the noise floor directly (+/-5% in run 1, +/-1% in run 2). IQ3_S and IQ3_XXS clear it in both runs.

instruction_counts.tool: device ISA, gfx1151, bf16-out, T=8, R=1, per inner body
instruction_counts.note: VALU falls as well as loads, because LDS addressing is cheaper than 64-bit global addressing. This is why the change does not repeat the rejected IQ4 codebook trade, which removed loads by adding VALU.

iq2_s_grid_staging.reason: The LDS footprint costs more occupancy than the 16 removed loads per body return. Excluded by measurement; the exclusion and its number are recorded in the kernel source.

correctness.exact_parity: tests/test_gguf_ud_dense.py 84/84 bit-exact vs the 128-strided-accumulator reference plus the CPU outer KL/top-1 gate

limitations: Laptop power/clock limited; ratios provisional pending the desktop gfx1151 host.
IQ2_XS read +5.0% and +10.1% in two runs, so its magnitude is unsettled even though its direction is consistent.
Staging helps decode (rows=1). Its effect at prefill row slabs was not separately measured.
